findings.finding: An amended and restated $100m at-the-market facility with H.C. Wainwright (agreement 2026-08-28, prospectus supplement 2026-08-31 amended 2026-09-04, S-3 effective) was fully undrawn as of 09-04 and priced at an assumed $1.14; at $2.86 the company can sell into any 09-30 bounce, and nothing prevents a draw tonight or tomorrow.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The facility is live and effective every session; draws are discretionary and daily, so supply can meet a bounce on 09-30 itself. It is invisible until the next 10-Q/8-K, which is why the tape cannot price the size of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dated ATM-draw disclosure to measure against; this name's own comparable falls since the pump alternate violently (09-16 -> +22.43%, 09-18 -> -12.96%, 09-21 -> +29.13%, 09-28 -> -13.07%), so the facility has not stopped bounces, only possibly capped them.
findings.why_not_priced: The facility has been public for a month, so its existence is priced; what is not is how much of the $100m (against a ~$440m market cap at spot, ~2.5x the price it was sized at) is being sold into the tape. If the market held heavy daily issuance, rallies like 09-16 and 09-21 would not have run +22-29%.
findings.independence: The 8-K/A of 2026-09-08 carrying the amended ATM agreement (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1857044/000149315226041636/form8-ka.htm) is the same programme, not independent evidence of draws. None independent.

outside_window.finding: Resale registration for the 20,338,974 placement shares bought at ~$1.18 (≈13% of the enlarged share count, ~140% in the money at $2.86); ex10-1 sets no filing or effectiveness deadline, and Reg S purchasers are restricted from US resale for six months absent registration, so the overhang lands when the resale S-3 is declared effective, date unknown and almost certainly after 09-30.
